An '''acklay''' fought and was [[Death|killed]] at [[Petranaki Arena]] during the [[First Battle of Geonosis]].<ref name="Episode II" />

==Biography==
After [[Anakin Skywalker]], [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]], and [[Padmé Amidala Naberrie|Padmé Amidala]] were captured by [[Count]] [[Dooku]], the [[Sith Lord]] had them be executed at the [[Petranaki Arena]] on the [[planet]] [[Geonosis]]. This acklay, along with an [[Unidentified reek|reek]] and an [[Unidentified nexu|nexu]], were chosen to kill the three. However, Kenobi managed to escape from his chains and fought the beast.
[[File:Acklay_Obi-Wan.jpg|thumb|right|250px|[[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] facing the acklay]]
After the [[Jedi Order]] presented themselves at the scene, a fight began to break out in the arena. During this time, Kenobi obtained his [[lightsaber]], and slashed at the beasts feet and stabbed it in the chest, ending the acklay. Kenobi and the rest of the Jedi Order escaped the arena not long after.<ref name="Episode II" />
